FINDING: chatService.ts:347-392 postTurn() builds the envelope from the locally-validated `question`/`scope` request variables on EVERY publish attempt, including the `result.created === false` (idempotency-key-match / retry) path, rather than from `result.userTurn.content`/`result.userTurn.scope` — the row that was actually committed and is what the idempotency guarantee is supposed to protect.
